# CVGrid Convert

> Free, browser-native PDF converter and document utilities built for complete privacy. Zero files are uploaded to remote servers; all document rendering and processing occurs directly on the user's device via client-side WebAssembly and JavaScript (pdf-lib and pdf.js).

## Core Capabilities & Online Tools

- [PDF to JPG Converter](https://convert.cvgrid.in/pdf-to-jpg): Convert single or multi-page PDF documents into crystal-clear, high-resolution JPG images.
- [JPG to PDF Converter](https://convert.cvgrid.in/jpg-to-pdf): Turn multiple JPG photos into a single, clean PDF file with customizable A4/Letter sizing.
- [PDF to PNG Converter](https://convert.cvgrid.in/pdf-to-png): Lossless conversion of PDF pages to high-resolution PNG images, preserving fine details and signatures.
- [PNG to PDF Converter](https://convert.cvgrid.in/png-to-pdf): Combine transparent and lossless PNG images into unified, ready-to-share PDF documents.
- [Multiple PDF to Image Converter](https://convert.cvgrid.in/pdf-to-image): Convert batch PDF documents into high-resolution PNG or JPG images at 2x density with ZIP export.
- [Multiple Images to PDF Converter](https://convert.cvgrid.in/image-to-pdf): Stack and combine multiple JPG, PNG, WebP, or GIF images into formatted PDFs with custom page sizes (Fit Image, A4, US Letter), orientation, and margins.
- [Merge PDF Files](https://convert.cvgrid.in/merge): Stitch multiple PDF files into one consolidated document with visual drag-and-drop reordering.
- [Split PDF Pages](https://convert.cvgrid.in/split): Extract specific pages or custom page ranges from multi-page documents with instant visual page selection.
- [Compress PDF](https://convert.cvgrid.in/compress): Reduce PDF file size below 2MB for ATS job application portals while preserving text layers, fonts, and layout.

## Key Facts & Privacy Model

- **100% Client-Side:** Files never leave the browser. Zero server storage, zero telemetry on document contents.
- **No Limits:** Unlimited conversions, no file size caps, no sign-up or subscription required.
- **ATS Compatible:** Document text streams and formatting remain intact for Applicant Tracking Systems.
- **Parent Platform:** Part of the CVGrid ecosystem (https://cvgrid.in), offering AI resume building, ATS checking, and career tools.
